newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kong Tai buys out unit for HK$52 mln.
newsitem.headline: Kong Tai buys out unit for HK$52 mln.

text.p: Kong Tai International Holdings Co Ltd said it would buy an 80 percent stake in Pacific Engineering Ltd from David Resources Co Ltd for HK$52 million, making it a 100 percent-owned unit of Kong Tai.
Kong Tai said HK$15.48 million of the purchase would be paid in cash and the remaining HK$36.52 million would be satisfied by an issue of 88 million new company shares at HK$0.415 each.

David Resources is wholly-owned by David Wong, managing director and a major shareholder of Kong Tai. On completion of the deal, Wong's stake in Kong Tai would be increased to 27.1 percent from 22.67 percent.
Pacific Engineering engages in supply of construction materials and sand to contractors and developers in Hong Kong mainly for infrastructure projects.
Kong Tai shares rose HK$0.015 to HK$0.42 at midday.
